title: GTA6 Clipper: Find Highlights in a Long Stream

facts.limits: Optional AI and publishing services may cost money; permissions needed for footage.

scenes.say: Stop scrubbing through hours of streams for one good moment.
scenes.heading: TURN STREAMS INTO SHORTS

scenes.say: GTA Six Clipper helps turn streams into vertical Shorts.
scenes.heading: MEET THE TOOL

scenes.say: Give it a Twitch, YouTube, or Kick link. It transcribes the stream locally and looks for spikes in chat and loudness.
scenes.heading: FIND PEAKS

scenes.say: It uses those signals to suggest moments. An AI pass is optional.
scenes.heading: PICK A MOMENT

scenes.say: Then it can stack the streamer above the game, add a hook, and create word-by-word captions.
scenes.heading: BUILD THE SHORT

scenes.say: You review each clip, adjust the edit, and keep the original.
scenes.heading: REVIEW

scenes.say: The tool is free, though optional AI and publishing services may cost money.
scenes.heading: THE CATCH

scenes.say: Want the tool? Comment CLIP and follow Hypeless for more tools, minus the hype.
scenes.heading: YOUR CALL

viewer.job: Understand how a stream becomes a reviewable vertical clip

idea: Turn stream highlights into vertical shorts with a review step.

claims.text: GTA6 Clipper transcribes, ranks candidate moments and renders vertical clips.

review.notes: User approved script and visual review; optional service pricing and creator footage caveats included.
